name: agile-scrum-kanban
description: Use when the user asks about Scrum vs Kanban, sprint planning, Definition of Done, WIP limits, cycle time, throughput, Monte Carlo forecasts, cumulative flow diagrams, Scrumban, SAFe or LeSS. Produces an agile approach, board policies and data-based forecasts. Not for retrospectives (use sprint-retro) or team boundaries (use management-team-topology).
